name: Ideal Time's buff carries a single charge (#3662)
contract: Ideal Time's buff 807210 reads "Your next ability is guaranteed to critically strike" in both its Description and its AuraDescription, and Spell.dbc gives it DurationIndex 1 = 10000 ms. A buff that applies to one ability and no more is expressed in this core by a charge: Aura::CalcMaxCharges reads SpellInfo::ProcCharges, Aura::IsUsingCharges is false while that is zero, and both consumers - Player::RemoveSpellMods (Player.cpp:10470-10471) and Aura::PrepareProcToTrigger (SpellAuras.cpp:2133-2137) - spend a charge only for an aura that is using charges. 807210 ships ProcCharges 0, so the buff cannot be one-shot by any mechanism and instead lasts its full 10 seconds. The two effects stay as authored: effect 0 is Aura=290 (SPELL_AURA_MOD_CRIT_PCT) with EffectBasePoints 99 and EffectDieSides 1, a +100 stat bonus to every critical chance, and effect 1 is Aura=107 (SPELL_AURA_ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER) with EffectMiscValue 7 = SPELLMOD_CRITICAL_CHANCE, the same +100, class-masked to [0,268435456,0] (Accelerated Recovery). The charge must not disable that modifier: Player::IsAffectedBySpellmod rejects a charged mod only for a real cast that has run out of charges, and the spell_modifier metric submits no cast, so the flat +100 must still read back with the charge in place.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
Fixture Ideal Time's buff as its 30-second periodic grant would leave it
Ideal Time's buff carries exactly one charge
The charge leaves the guaranteed-critical modifier intact
